question: Which government honoured a distinguished percussionist named Pandit Anindo Chatterjee with the Banga Vibhushan Award in 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**West Bengal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Pandit Anindo Chatterjee:-

 
 
• Anindo Chatterjee is known for his mastery of tabla, excelling in various styles including khayal and thumri.
 
• He has performed with many renowned classical musicians and has participated in international music festivals.
 
• His awards:
 
 
• Sangeet Natak Akademi Award (2012).
 
• Acknowledged as a leading tabla player in various music festivals and competitions.
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **S****angeet **Natak Akademi Award 

 
 
• The Sangeet Natak Akademi is India's national academy for music, dance, and drama. It was established in 1952 by the Indian government.
 
• The Akademi Awards are the highest national recognition given to practicing artists.
 
• Bharatanatyam has its roots in the Natya Shastra, an ancient treatise on performing arts written by Bharata Muni.
 
• This dance form is traditionally performed by women, but in contemporary times, it is also performed by men.
 
• The themes of Bharatanatyam performances are usually derived from Hindu mythology and epics.
